title: A canvas can take its height from what it draws
body: A canvas's `size` is two fixed numbers. With panels in a `stack`, a figure's height comes from its contents, and `figures/key-schemes.acre` had to be raised by hand when its stack grew past 3020 pixels. `size W auto`, or `size auto auto`, would take the box around everything drawn, measured as `Scene::bounds` does, plus a `margin`.
